transcript: Speaker A: Oh, what an amazing shot! Yaar, ye goalkeeper kya kar raha hai? He ate the goal again. [Man, what is this goalkeeper doing? He ate the goal again.] Speaker B: Ek minute. He ate the goal? Bhai, goalkeeper hai, koi food blogger nahi hai jo ki goal ko kha jayega. Sahi English hoti hai, "He conceded a goal." [One minute. He ate the goal? Jab tu usse personally baat karega, woh ye batayega ki tu kahan pe galti kar raha hai, lekin saath hi saath ye bhi batayega ki use sahi kaise karna hai. Yaani ki teri fluency aur vocabulary dono sahi ho jaani hai. [Not huh, yes. This is an app on the phone, okay? In this, you get Riva AI, which is your personal English language coach. [Yes, just 7 rupees.] Speaker C: English speaking seekhna hai toh PW Talk app abhi download karo. [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]
